user_prompt:
The figure below shows a spinner with 24 sectors. When someone spins the arrow, it is equally likely to stop on any sector.

[Image: Spinner with 24 sectors]

1/8 of the sectors are blue, 1/24 are purple, 1/2 are orange, and 1/3 are red. If a person spins the arrow, on which color sector is the spinner LEAST likely to stop?

Figure, described in words:
A circular spinner divided equally into 24 sectors by radial line segments from a central pivot point. An arrow is mounted at the center, pointing toward the sector at approximately the 1 o'clock position. The sectors are plain white and unlabeled.

A. blue
B. purple
C. orange
D. red
